test_scenarios.scenario_name: ENRICHED VDB SEARCH - Legal Document Summary + Query Enhancement
test_scenarios.description: Extract document summary, enrich user query with it, then search VDB for related statutes/guidance. Returns full answer with citations to legal sources.
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: System should extract document summary, add keywords to user query, search Milvus VDB, return statute-related results with high relevance, include source citations in answer

queries.text: Find legal guidance about employee management and work hour regulations for Norwegian companies
queries.enrichment_keywords: employee management, work hours, flexible schedules, employment practices
queries.expected_vdb_results: Should retrieve statutes related to employment law, working hours, labor regulations
queries.expected_answer_preview: Should cite relevant Norwegian employment law, work hour regulations, and labor standards

queries.text: Hva sier norsk lovgivning om datavern og sikkerhetskrav i IT-selskaper?
queries.expected_vdb_results: Should find data protection, information security, and IT-related statutory requirements
queries.expected_answer_preview: Should cite Norwegian data protection law (GDPR), information security requirements, and IT compliance regulations
